- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for cleaning silver jewelry: 
  - Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive materials, or hot water.
  - Dry jewelry thoroughly to prevent water spots.
  - Store silver jewelry in a cool, dry place.
  - Use silver polishing cloths or storage bags with anti-tarnish properties.
